name: Compare folders
description: What is only on one side, and what is on both but different. The two panels are the two sides.
author: xcommander

views.title: Compare folders
views.description: The left panel against the right one.

settings.label: Walk subfolders
settings.note: Off compares only what is in the two folders themselves.

settings.label: Show what matches
settings.note: Off is what the tool is for: only the differences. On lists everything, which is worth having when you expect two folders to be identical.

settings.label: Compare by content
settings.note: Reads both files and compares them byte for byte, for the pairs whose size matches. Sure, and much slower — every byte of both folders is read.

settings.label: Include hidden files
settings.note: They are differences like any other. Turn it off on a Mac, where every folder anybody has looked at carries a .DS_Store that nobody put there.

settings.label: Times may differ by
settings.note: Seconds. Two seconds by default, because a FAT volume keeps times to that and a file copied to one comes back looking a second older.

settings.label: Stop after
settings.note: Entries. A walk that never ends is worse than one that says where it stopped.
